{"consolidated_memory":"notifications/email/render.py: Six separate broken layout incidents in email renderer (Jan–Jul 2026)

Component: notifications/email/render.py (Python)
Common symptom across all: table overflows in the plain text part of the email renderer
Common repro: render the digest template with a long subject
Tests covering these fixes: tests/notifications/test_render.py

OCCASION 1 [2026-01-31]
- Trigger: jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: off-by-one in the slice bound
- Fix: corrected the slice bound; added property test around it
- PR #1579, branch fix/broken-layout-1
- Result: alert stayed quiet for 40 consecutive days

OCCASION 2 [2026-03-09]
- Trigger: accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Root cause: listener registered but never removed
- Fix: removed listener on teardown; asserted removal in test
- PR #2916, branch fix/broken-layout-2
- Result: 51 duplicate rows per day stopped being written

OCCASION 3 [2026-03-18]
- Trigger: records carrying non-ASCII names
- Root cause: naive datetime compared against an aware datetime
- Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- PR #3438, branch fix/broken-layout-3
- Result: cold start dropped 90 percent (to 577 ms)

OCCASION 4 [2026-03-25]
- Trigger: first request after a cold start
- Root cause: clock skew between two hosts
- Fix: switched deadline to a monotonic clock
- PR #3933, branch fix/broken-layout-4
- Result: error rate dropped from 3.3% to under 4 per ten thousand

OCCASION 5 [2026-05-19]
- Trigger: payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Root cause: missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- Fix: added composite index; backfilled in batches
- PR #6070, branch fix/broken-layout-5
- Result: p99 latency fell from 5.2 s to 207 ms

OCCASION 6 [2026-07-10]
- Trigger: after rolling restart of the fleet
- Root cause: error swallowed by bare except
- Fix: narrowed the exception handler; let failure propagate
- PR #8686, branch fix/broken-layout-6
- Result: nightly rollup matched source counts for 6 consecutive days"}
